Ask about the details your family needs, and follow the instructions on the actual cart. Keep the person’s usual communication tools within reach.Print these results Download all listings (CSV) More stores, and the original cart.Walmart’s current policy covers all its U.S. stores; the locations above are a selection. Use Walmart’s store finder for another town. Walmart also publishes daily sensory-friendly hours of 8–10 a.m.; check the branch page for visit details.Target’s 2016 rollout announcement excluded some of its smallest stores. Ask a local Hannaford for a fresh confirmation.What happened to Caroline’s Cart’s own directory?Older resources linked to state lists at carolinescart.com. We have not treated those unavailable lists as current evidence.Wanzl’s Caroline’s Cart page has product information, safety literature and a store request form. Caroline’s Cause tells the origin story. How we know what we know.Official store pages supply addresses and phone numbers. The cart evidence is linked separately below. Policy listings describe a retailer’s published provision; chain reports do not confirm a specific branch; older local reports need reconfirmation.
